summary: QA- End to End Validation for JavaScript tool "JSINSPECT"
description:
## Summary

Perform end-to-end validation of the **JSINSPECT** tool on a **JavaScript** repository using the Testable QA environment. Verify successful execution, metric/report accuracy, and correct platform ingestion.

### Objective

Validate that **JSINSPECT** integrates correctly with the Testable White Box analysis pipeline and produces the expected outputs mapped in **Testable_Strategy_Metrics_Mapping_v0.2** (White Box sheet).

TypeScript secondary tool on Code Duplication rows; validate jsinspect duplication findings on JavaScript repositories.

### Strategy Mapping Reference

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Source file | Testable_Strategy_Metrics_Mapping_v0.2 (White Box sheet) |
| Tool | JSINSPECT |
| Metrics covered by this tool | **7** |
| Language focus | JavaScript |

### Metrics Covered (from Strategy v0.2)

| L3 Technique | L4 Classification | L5 Metric | JS Primary | JS Secondary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Code Duplication | Defect Propagation Risk Detection | Multi-Point Failure Probability | jscpd | — |
| Code Duplication | Refactoring Identification | Redundancy Localization | jscpd | — |
| Code Duplication | Code Quality Assessment | Structural Cleanliness Score | jscpd | — |
| Code Duplication | Test Maintenance Reduction | Test Suite Streamlining | jscpd | — |
| Code Duplication | Refactoring Opportunity Detection | Abstraction Potential | jscpd | — |
| Code Duplication | Risk-Based Testing Prioritization | Regression Focus Mapping | jscpd | — |
| Code Duplication | Maintainability Testing | Synchronization Verification | jscpd | — |

### Validation Scope

* Verify the tool executes successfully on a representative JavaScript repository.
* Confirm raw tool output is generated without errors.
* Validate mapped metrics above are present directly or via documented derivation.
* Compare platform-ingested values with local tool execution.
* Ensure reports are stored/displayed correctly in Testable.

### Expected Result

* **JSINSPECT** completes execution successfully.
* All **7** mapped metrics are supported or correctly derived.
* Results display correctly in Testable without tool failure messages.

### Deliverables

* End-to-end validation results
* Execution logs
* Generated JSINSPECT report/output
* Screenshots of successful execution (if applicable)
